169	  build): `avr8`, `elbrus-e1cp`, `pic8`, `pic8-enhanced`, `pic16`, `mips32`. Also rejected:
170	  `Unix64`, `WIN64` (case-sensitive).
171	- `--platform=<file>`: a nonexistent path `/tmp/nonexistent_platform.xml` AND an existing junk
172	  file both → `cppcheck: error: unrecognized platform: '<path>'.`
173	
174	### `--showtime=`
175	- `--showtime=` → `cppcheck: error: no mode provided for --showtime` (no period)
176	- `--showtime=bad` → `cppcheck: error: unrecognized --showtime mode: 'bad'. Supported modes: file, file-total, summary, top5_file, top5_summary.` (verbatim, 123 bytes; trailing period)
177	- Accepted: `none file file-total summary top5_file top5_summary`. Rejected: `top5`.
178	
179	### `--language=` / `-x`
180	- `--language=bad`, `-x bad` → `cppcheck: error: unknown language 'bad' enforced.` (trailing period)
181	- `--language=` → `cppcheck: error: unknown language '' enforced.`
182	- `-x none` → `cppcheck: error: unknown language 'none' enforced.`
183	- Accepted: `c`, `c++` (both `--language=` and `-x` forms) → `[std.cfg failure]`.
184	- `-x` consumes the NEXT argv element (space-separated only; `-xc` is unrecognized).
185	
186	### `--output-format=`
187	- Bad/empty/wrong-case (`bad`, ``, `Text`, `XML`) all →
188	  `cppcheck: error: argument to '--output-format=' must be 'text', 'sarif', 'xml' (deprecated), 'xmlv2' or 'xmlv3'.`
189	- Accepted: `text sarif xml xmlv2 xmlv3`.
190	
191	### `--report-type=`
192	- `--report-type=bad` → `cppcheck: error: Unknown report type 'bad'` (capital U, no period)
193	- `--report-type=` → `cppcheck: error: Unknown report type ''`
194	- Accepted: `normal autosar cert-c-2016 cert-cpp-2016 misra-c-2012 misra-c-2023 misra-c-2025 misra-cpp-2008 misra-cpp-2023`. Rejected: `misra-c-2019`, `CERT-C` (case-sensitive).
195	
196	### `--check-level=`
197	- `--check-level=bad` → `cppcheck: error: unknown '--check-level' value 'bad'.` (trailing period)
198	- `--check-level=` → `cppcheck: error: unknown '--check-level' value ''.`
199	- Accepted: `reduced normal exhaustive`. Rejected: `Normal` (case-sensitive).
200	
201	## 5. Numeric options
202	
203	### `--error-exitcode=<n>` (parsed with stoll semantics; NO range check on the result)
204	- `=abc`, `=`, `=12abc`-style junk → `cppcheck: error: argument to '--error-exitcode=' is not valid - not an integer.`
205	  (`=12abc` verified via `--max-configs=12abc`; `--error-exitcode=1abc` → same message)
206	- `=999999999999999999999` → `cppcheck: error: argument to '--error-exitcode=' is not valid - out of range (stoll).`
207	- `=-1`, `=0`, `=255`, `=256`, `=+5`, `= 5` (leading space!) → all ACCEPTED
208	  (with no file: `no C or C++ source files found.`; with `t.c`: `[std.cfg failure]`).
209	
210	### `-j <n>` (stoull semantics)
211	- `-jabc`, `-j=4`, `-j1.5` → `cppcheck: error: argument to '-j' is not valid - not an integer.`
212	- `-j0` / `-j 0` → `cppcheck: error: argument for '-j' must be greater than 0.`
213	  (note: "argument for", different wording than the others)
214	- `-j-1` → `cppcheck: error: argument to '-j' is not valid - needs to be positive.`
215	- `-j999999999999999999999` → `cppcheck: error: argument to '-j' is not valid - out of range (stoull).`
216	- `-j 4 t.c`, `-j+4 t.c` → accepted (`[std.cfg failure]`).
217	
218	### `-l <n>` (integer only)
219	- `-labc`, `-l0.5` → `cppcheck: error: argument to '-l' is not valid - not an integer.`
220	- `-l0 t.c`, `-l 2 t.c`, `-l-1 t.c` → accepted (`[std.cfg failure]`).
221	
222	### `--max-configs=<n>`
223	- `=abc`, `=`, `=12abc`, `=1.5` → `cppcheck: error: argument to '--max-configs=' is not valid - not an integer.`
224	- `=0`, `=-1` → `cppcheck: error: argument to '--max-configs=' must be greater than 0.`
225	
226	### `--max-ctu-depth=<n>`
227	- `=abc`, `=`, `=1.5` → `cppcheck: error: argument to '--max-ctu-depth=' is not valid - not an integer.`
228	- `=-1`, `=0` → ACCEPTED (no-files error / `[std.cfg failure]` respectively).
229	
230	## 6. File-dependent options (opened DURING parse, in argv order)
231	
232	- `--file-list=/nonexistent.txt` → `cppcheck: error: couldn't open the file: "/nonexistent.txt".`
233	- `--file-list=` → `cppcheck: error: couldn't open the file: "".` 
234	- `--suppressions-list=/nonexistent.txt` → `cppcheck: error: couldn't open the file: "/nonexistent.txt".` (same message)
235	- `--includes-file=/nonexistent.txt t.c` → `cppcheck: error: unable to open includes file at '/nonexistent.txt'` (single quotes, **no trailing period**)
236	- `--project=/nonexistent.sln` → `cppcheck: error: failed to open project '/nonexistent.sln'. The file does not exist.`
237	- `--project=` → `cppcheck: error: failed to open project ''. The file does not exist.`
238	- `--file-list=-` with empty stdin → `cppcheck: error: no C or C++ source files found.`;
239	  with `t.c\n` on stdin → `[std.cfg failure]`.
240	- `--library=` → `cppcheck: error: empty library specified.` (parse-time, trailing period)
241	- `--library=nonexistent t.c` / `--library=posix t.c` → `[std.cfg failure]`
242	  (library existence is NOT checked before the std.cfg load).
243	- `--include=/nonexistent.h t.c` → `[std.cfg failure]` (not checked at parse time).
244	- `--output-file= t.c` → `[std.cfg failure]` (empty value accepted here).
245	- Positional input paths are NOT checked for existence or extension before analysis start:
246	  `nope.c`, an existing directory, `t.c.txt` (nonexistent), `header.h` (nonexistent) →
247	  all `[std.cfg failure]`.
248	- `--suppress=` → `cppcheck: error: Failed to add suppression. No id.` (trailing period);
249	  `--suppress=foo t.c` → `[std.cfg failure]`.
250	
251	## 7. The "no input files" error
252	
253	Any fully valid command line with no input files → stdout, exit 1:
254	```
255	cppcheck: error: no C or C++ source files found.
256	```
257	Seen for: bare valid options only, e.g. `-rp`, `--std=c++2a`, `--error-exitcode=-1`,
258	`--platform=bad --platform=unix64`, `--max-ctu-depth=-1`, `--file-list=-` (empty stdin).
259	
260	## 8. Early-exit options and precedence
261	
262	Early-exit options: `-h`/`--help` (20176-byte help), `--version` (`Cppcheck 2.19 dev\n`, 18 bytes),
263	`--errorlist` (105141-byte XML). Rules:
264	
265	- The **first** of these three in argv order wins and short-circuits EVERYTHING, exit 0 — even if
266	  an earlier argument is invalid:
267	  - `--bogus --version` → version, exit 0. `--version --bogus` → version, exit 0.
268	  - `--bogus --help` → help, exit 0. `--help --bogus` → help, exit 0.
269	  - `--bogus --errorlist` → errorlist, exit 0. `--errorlist --std=bad` → errorlist, exit 0.
270	  - `--help --version` → help. `--version --help` → version.
271	  - `--errorlist --version` → errorlist. `--version --errorlist` → version.
272	  - `--errorlist --help` → errorlist. `--help --errorlist` → help.
273	- `-h` output is byte-identical to `--help`.
274	
275	## 9. Precedence between ordinary errors (all without early-exit options)
276	
277	Observed pairs:
278	
279	| Command | Winner |
280	|---|---|
281	| `--std=bad --platform=bad` | `unknown --std value 'bad'` |
282	| `--platform=bad --std=bad` | `unknown --std value 'bad'` |
283	| `--bogus --std=bad` | `unrecognized command line option: "--bogus".` |
284	| `--std=bad --bogus` | `unknown --std value 'bad'` |
285	| `--std=bad t.c` | `unknown --std value 'bad'` |
286	| `--enable=bad --std=bad` | `--enable parameter with the unknown name 'bad'` |
287	| `--std=bad --enable=bad` | `unknown --std value 'bad'` |
288	| `-j0 --std=bad` | `argument for '-j' must be greater than 0.` |
289	| `--std=bad -j0` | `unknown --std value 'bad'` |
290	| `--bogus1 --bogus2` | `unrecognized command line option: "--bogus1".` |
291	| `--platform=bad --bogus` | `unrecognized command line option: "--bogus".` |
292	| `--bogus --platform=bad` | `unrecognized command line option: "--bogus".` |
293	| `--platform=bad --platform=unix64` | (no error — last value wins; then no-files error) |
294	| `--platform=unix64 --platform=bad` | `unrecognized platform: 'bad'.` |
295	| `--platform= --std=bad` | `empty platform specified.` |
296	| `--std=bad --platform=` | `unknown --std value 'bad'` |
297	| `-x none --std=bad` | `unknown language 'none' enforced.` |
298	| `--std=bad -x none` | `unknown --std value 'bad'` |
299	| `--std=bad --std=c11` | `unknown --std value 'bad'` (first bad one) |
300	| `--std=c11 --std=bad` | `unknown --std value 'bad'` |
301	| `--file-list=/nonexistent.txt --std=bad` | `couldn't open the file: "/nonexistent.txt".` |
302	| `--std=bad --file-list=/nonexistent.txt` | `unknown --std value 'bad'` |
303	| `--file-list=/nonexistent.txt --bogus` | `couldn't open the file: "/nonexistent.txt".` |
304	| `--bogus --file-list=/nonexistent.txt` | `unrecognized command line option: "--bogus".` |
305	| `--includes-file=/nonexistent.txt --std=bad` | `unable to open includes file at '/nonexistent.txt'` |
306	| `--std=bad --includes-file=/nonexistent.txt` | `unknown --std value 'bad'` |
307	| `--project=/nonexistent.sln --std=bad` | `failed to open project '/nonexistent.sln'. The file does not exist.` |
308	| `--std=bad --project=/nonexistent.sln` | `unknown --std value 'bad'` |
309	| `--file-list=/nonexistent.txt --project=/nonexistent.sln` | `couldn't open the file: "/nonexistent.txt".` |
310	| `--project=/nonexistent.sln --file-list=/nonexistent.txt` | `failed to open project '/nonexistent.sln'. ...` |
311	| `--includes-file=/nonexistent.txt --suppressions-list=/nonexistent2.txt t.c` | `unable to open includes file at '/nonexistent.txt'` |
312	| `--suppressions-list=/nonexistent2.txt --includes-file=/nonexistent.txt t.c` | `couldn't open the file: "/nonexistent2.txt".` |
313	| `--platform=bad --file-list=/nonexistent.txt` | `couldn't open the file: "/nonexistent.txt".` |
314	| `--platform=bad --includes-file=/nonexistent.txt t.c` | `unable to open includes file at '/nonexistent.txt'` |
315	| `--platform=bad --project=/nonexistent.sln` | `failed to open project '/nonexistent.sln'. ...` |
316	| `--platform=bad --file-list=-` (empty stdin) | `unrecognized platform: 'bad'.` |
317	| `--enable=bad --file-list=/nonexistent.txt` | `--enable parameter with the unknown name 'bad'` |
318	
319	---
320	
321	## KEY RULES
322	
323	1. **Stream routing**: everything — errors, help, version, errorlist — goes to **stdout**. Stderr
324	   is always empty in every probed scenario. Parse/validation errors exit **1**; early-exit
325	   outputs exit **0**.
326	
327	2. **Processing pipeline / precedence** (first failure at each stage aborts the rest):
328	   - **Stage 0 — early-exit scan**: the first of `-h`/`--help`, `--version`, `--errorlist` in argv
329	     order is executed and the program exits 0, regardless of any other arguments (even invalid
330	     ones appearing earlier).
331	   - **Stage 1 — left-to-right parse**: arguments are processed in argv order and the FIRST error
332	     wins. This includes: unrecognized-option errors, missing short-option values, all enumerated
333	     value validations (`--std`, `--enable`, `--disable`, `--language`/`-x`, `--output-format`,
334	     `--report-type`, `--check-level`, `--showtime`), all numeric validations (`-j`, `-l`,
335	     `--max-configs`, `--max-ctu-depth`, `--error-exitcode`), empty-value checks
336	     (`--platform=`, `--library=`, `-rp=`, `--suppress=`), and **opening the files named by
337	     `--file-list`, `--includes-file`, `--suppressions-list`, `--project`** (these are opened
338	     immediately when the option is parsed, so they interleave with other parse errors in argv
339	     order).
340	   - **Stage 2 — deferred platform check**: after a fully successful parse, the FINAL `--platform`
341	     value is validated (`unrecognized platform: '%1%'.`). Repeated `--platform` options: last one
342	     wins; earlier invalid ones are forgiven. `--platform=` (empty) is instead a Stage-1 error
343	     (`empty platform specified.`).
344	   - **Stage 3 — input presence check**: `cppcheck: error: no C or C++ source files found.`
345	   - **Stage 4 — analysis startup**: the 313-byte two-line `std.cfg` failure on stdout, exit 1.
346	
347	3. **Option syntax**:
348	   - Long options that take a value REQUIRE `--opt=value`; the bare form (`--std`) and the space
349	     form (`--std c11`) are both `unrecognized command line option: "--std".`
350	   - Short options `-I -D -U -i -j -l -x` accept both inline (`-I/tmp`) and space (`-I /tmp`)
351	     values; a following token starting with `-` is never consumed (→ `argument to '-X' is missing.`).
352	   - No bundling (`-fq` unrecognized), no abbreviations (`--vers`), case-sensitive everywhere,
353	     `--` and `-` are not special (both unrecognized).
354	   - `-rp` takes an optional value (`-rp`, `-rp path`, `-rp=path` OK; `-rp=` errors).
355	
356	4. **Message formats** (all on stdout, `\n`-terminated, exit 1):
357	   - `cppcheck: error: unrecognized command line option: "%1%".` — `%1%` = whole argv token.
358	   - `cppcheck: error: argument to '%1%' is missing.` — short opts `-I -D -U -j -l -i`.
359	   - `cppcheck: error: no language given to '-x' option.`
360	   - `cppcheck: error: unknown --std value '%1%'` (no period).
361	   - `cppcheck: error: --enable parameter is empty` / `--enable parameter with the unknown name '%1%'`
362	     (same for `--disable` with `--disable` prefix). Empty comma-token bug:
363	     `cppcheck: error: --enable--enable parameter is empty` and (for disable!)
364	     `cppcheck: error: --disable--enable parameter is empty`.
365	   - `cppcheck: error: empty platform specified.` / `cppcheck: error: unrecognized platform: '%1%'.`
366	   - `cppcheck: error: no mode provided for --showtime` /
367	     `cppcheck: error: unrecognized --showtime mode: '%1%'. Supported modes: file, file-total, summary, top5_file, top5_summary.`
368	   - `cppcheck: error: unknown language '%1%' enforced.`
369	   - `cppcheck: error: argument to '--output-format=' must be 'text', 'sarif', 'xml' (deprecated), 'xmlv2' or 'xmlv3'.`
370	   - `cppcheck: error: Unknown report type '%1%'` (capital U, no period).
371	   - `cppcheck: error: unknown '--check-level' value '%1%'.`
372	   - Numeric: `cppcheck: error: argument to '%1%' is not valid - not an integer.` /
373	     `... is not valid - out of range (stoll).` (only `--error-exitcode`) /
374	     `... is not valid - out of range (stoull).` (only `-j`) /
375	     `cppcheck: error: argument for '-j' must be greater than 0.` (only `-j0`; "for", not "to") /
376	     `cppcheck: error: argument to '-j' is not valid - needs to be positive.` (only `-j-1`) /
377	     `cppcheck: error: argument to '--max-configs=' must be greater than 0.`
378	   - File options: `cppcheck: error: couldn't open the file: "%1%".` (file-list & suppressions-list) /
379	     `cppcheck: error: unable to open includes file at '%1%'` (no period) /
380	     `cppcheck: error: failed to open project '%1%'. The file does not exist.` /
381	     `cppcheck: error: empty library specified.` /
382	     `cppcheck: error: no paths specified for the '-rp=' option.` /
383	     `cppcheck: error: Failed to add suppression. No id.` (empty `--suppress=`).
384	   - `cppcheck: error: no C or C++ source files found.`
385	
386	5. **Not validated before the std.cfg failure**: existence of positional input paths/dirs (any
387	   extension, even nonexistent), `--library=<name>` (except empty), `--include=<file>`,
388	   `--output-file=` (empty OK), `--template=`/`--template-location=` (any string, incl. empty/junk),
389	   `--error-exitcode` result range (`-1`, `256`, `+5`, ` 5` all OK), `--max-ctu-depth=-1`, `-l-1`.
390	
391	6. **Valid value sets** (case-sensitive):
392	   - `--std`: c89 c90 c99 c11 c17 c18 c23 c2x c2y, gnu89 gnu99 gnu11 gnu17 gnu23 gnu2x gnu2y,
393	     c++98 c++03 c++11 c++14 c++17 c++20 c++23 c++26, c++0x c++1y c++1z c++2a c++2b c++2c,
394	     gnu++98 gnu++03 gnu++11 gnu++14 gnu++17 gnu++20 gnu++23 gnu++26,
395	     gnu++1y gnu++1z gnu++2a gnu++2b gnu++2c.
396	   - `--enable`/`--disable`: warning style performance portability information unusedFunction
397	     missingInclude all.
398	   - `--platform` (this build): unix32 unix64 win32A win32W win64 native unspecified.
399	     (avr8/elbrus-e1cp/pic8/pic8-enhanced/pic16/mips32 from --help are NOT compiled in.)
400	   - `--report-type`: normal autosar cert-c-2016 cert-cpp-2016 misra-c-2012 misra-c-2023
401	     misra-c-2025 misra-cpp-2008 misra-cpp-2023.
402	   - `--output-format`: text sarif xml xmlv2 xmlv3.
403	   - `--showtime`: none file file-total summary top5_file top5_summary.
404	   - `--check-level`: reduced normal exhaustive.
405	   - `--language`/`-x`: c c++.

338	## KEY RULES
339	
340	1. **Two processing stages.**
341	   - **Stage 1 — command-line parse, strictly left-to-right:** the FIRST failing option
342	     on the command line wins; its error is printed and the program exits 1 immediately.
343	     Validated here (in argument order): unrecognized options; `--project` (existence +
344	     full parse/load of .sln/.vcxproj/.bpr/compile_commands.json); `--suppressions-list`,
345	     `--exitcode-suppressions`, `--file-list` (open + parse each line); `--includes-file`,
346	     `--config-excludes-file` (open only); `--suppress-xml` (open + XML-parse + per-element
347	     validation); `--plist-output` (folder existence); `--rule`/`--rule-file`
348	     (unconditional "not built with rules support" rejection); `--library=` (empty-value
349	     check only).
350	   - **Stage 2 — after successful parse, fixed order:**
351	     a. `--cppcheck-build-dir` existence check
352	        (`Directory '%1%' specified by --cppcheck-build-dir argument has to be existent.`);
353	     b. `--project` + positional-files conjunction check
354	        (`--project cannot be used in conjunction with source files.`);
355	     c. source enumeration — zero files ⇒ `no C or C++ source files found.`;
356	     d. load `std` library from `/usr/local/share/Cppcheck/cfg/std.cfg` — always fails in
357	        this environment with the fixed two-line message (see §0).
358	   - Deferred to after std.cfg load (never observable here): `--library` name resolution,
359	     `--addon` resolution, listed/positional source-file existence, extension filtering,
360	     `--checkers-report`/`--output-file` file creation.
361	
362	2. **Stream routing:** EVERYTHING observed — parse errors, project errors, the std.cfg
363	   failure — goes to **stdout**. stderr was empty in every probe except the `[123]`
364	   JSON crash (C++ runtime terminate message on stderr, exit 134/SIGABRT). `--output-file`
365	   captures nothing in this environment and is never even created.
366	
367	3. **Exit codes:** 1 for every diagnosed error; 134 (SIGABRT) for a compile_commands.json
368	   array containing a non-object element (uncaught `std::runtime_error`:
369	   `"type mismatch! call is<type>() before get<type>()" && is<object>()`).
370	
371	4. **Message formats** (all stdout, newline-terminated, `%1%` = user-supplied value):
372	   - `cppcheck: error: unrecognized command line option: "%1%".`
373	   - `cppcheck: error: failed to open project '%1%'. The file does not exist.`
374	   - `cppcheck: error: <loader-specific line>` + `cppcheck: error: failed to load project '%1%'. An error occurred.`
375	     - loader lines: `Visual Studio solution file header not found`;
376	       `Visual Studio project file is not a valid XML - XML_ERROR_PARSING_TEXT`;
377	       `Borland project file is not a valid XML - XML_ERROR_PARSING_TEXT`;
378	       `compilation database is not a JSON array`;
379	       `no 'arguments' or 'command' field found in compilation database entry`;
380	       `'directory' field in compilation database entry missing`.
381	     - A bad/missing `file` field is NON-fatal: `skip compilation database entry because it does not have a proper 'file' field`, then loading continues (→ typically `no C or C++ source files found.`).
382	   - `cppcheck: error: couldn't open the file: "%1%".` (suppressions-list, exitcode-suppressions, file-list)
383	   - `cppcheck: error: Failed to add suppression. Invalid id "%1%"` (id = text before first `:`; ids containing spaces are invalid)
384	   - `cppcheck: error: Failed to add suppression. No id.`
385	   - `cppcheck: error: failed to load suppressions XML '%1%' (%2%).` where %2% is a TinyXML2 error name (`XML_ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND`, `XML_ERROR_PARSING_TEXT`, `XML_ERROR_PARSING_ATTRIBUTE`, …)
386	   - `cppcheck: error: invalid suppression xml file '%1%', expected 'suppress' element but got a '%2%'.`
387	   - `cppcheck: error: unable to open includes file at '%1%'` (no period)
388	   - `cppcheck: error: unable to open config excludes file at '%1%'` (no period)
389	   - `cppcheck: error: Option --rule cannot be used as Cppcheck has not been built with rules support.` (same for `--rule-file`)
390	   - `cppcheck: error: empty library specified.`
391	   - `cppcheck: error: Directory '%1%' specified by --cppcheck-build-dir argument has to be existent.`
392	   - `cppcheck: error: plist folder does not exist: '%1%'.`
393	   - `cppcheck: error: --project cannot be used in conjunction with source files.`
394	   - `cppcheck: error: no C or C++ source files found.`
395	   - std.cfg failure (verbatim, note first line has NO period after `File not found`, second line ends with `/usr/local/share/Cppcheck/cfg.`):
396	     ```
397	     cppcheck: Failed to load library configuration file 'std.cfg'. File not found
398	     Failed to load std.cfg. Your Cppcheck installation is broken, please re-install. The Cppcheck binary was compiled with FILESDIR set to "/usr/local/share/Cppcheck" and will therefore search for std.cfg in /usr/local/share/Cppcheck/cfg.
399	     ```
400	
401	5. **No file/dir side effects before std.cfg load:** `--cppcheck-build-dir` and
402	   `--plist-output` require pre-existing directories (never created); nothing is written
403	   into them; `--output-file` and `--checkers-report` files are never created.
404	   Directory passed where a file is expected (`--suppressions-list`, `--includes-file`,
405	   `--file-list`) opens "successfully" on Linux and is treated as empty.
406	
407	6. **Value syntax:** file options require `--opt=value`; bare `--checkers-report` (and
408	   presumably any `=`-option without value in place) is treated as an unrecognized option.

169	1. **The std.cfg failure is raw and unformattable.** It is always exactly the two baseline lines (313 B) on **stdout**, exit 1, and is emitted before/around any output machinery: `--template` (any value incl. empty, `{bogus}`, `{`, unknown names), `--template-location`, `--xml`, `--output-format=*` (all 5 valid values), `--xml-version=2|3`, and `--output-file` have ZERO effect on it. 173	5. **Parse errors are deferred:** invalid option values/unknown options do not abort the scan; the first such error is reported (stdout, exit 1) only if no meta flag is encountered.

178	10. **`-` is not a special file argument** — it is rejected as an unrecognized option.

188	Note the subtlety: an empty-string positional `""`, a nonexistent path, a `.txt` file, or an empty directory DO count as "a positional argument" and proceed to the std.cfg failure instead. The "no source files" check appears to be purely "was at least one positional path given", with all real path/extension validation deferred until after the (never-survived) library load.

190	## KEY RULES
191	
192	1. **Strict precedence pipeline** (first failure wins, all exit 1):
193	   1. Command-line parse/validation errors → `cppcheck: error: <specific message>` on stdout.
194	   2. Zero positional arguments → `cppcheck: error: no C or C++ source files found.` on stdout.

196	2. **Everything goes to stdout.** stderr was 0 bytes in every single probe, including all error cases. There is no error output on stderr ever.

Before the 2 lines, NOTHING is printed, under any flag.
198	4. **Exit code is hardwired to 1** for the std.cfg failure: `--error-exitcode=5` and even `--error-exitcode=0` do not change it. Parser errors and the no-files error are also exit 1.
199	5. **Quiet/verbose are no-ops for this failure**: `-q`, `--quiet`, `-v`, `--verbose`, and both together produce byte-identical output.
200	6. **Input existence/type is irrelevant**: valid C, broken C, empty file, header, `.txt`, directory, empty directory, nonexistent path, broken symlink, unreadable file, duplicates, and multiple inputs all yield the identical 313-byte stdout message.
201	7. **`-` and `--` are not special**: both are rejected as `cppcheck: error: unrecognized command line option: "%1%".` (with the literal token substituted). There is no stdin mode reachable via `-`.

204	   - Unknown std: `cppcheck: error: unknown --std value '%1%'` (NO trailing period)
205	   - Missing option argument: `cppcheck: error: argument to '%1%' is missing.`
206	   - Bad integer: `cppcheck: error: argument to '%1%' is not valid - not an integer.`
207	   - Non-positive: `cppcheck: error: argument for '-j' must be greater than 0.` / `cppcheck: error: argument to '--max-configs=' must be greater than 0.` (note "for" vs "to")
208	   - Bad showtime: `cppcheck: error: unrecognized --showtime mode: '%1%'. Supported modes: file, file-total, summary, top5_file, top5_summary.`
